title: ToolSource
description:
Where a tool node's operations came from.

`raw` is retained deliberately: §3d rule 5 requires re-import to diff operations by `method+path` and keep existing fills, and you cannot diff against a previous spec that was never stored.

raw.description: The document as imported. Empty for `manual`.

ToolFormat.description: The document format a tool node was imported from.

oneOf.description: Operations authored by hand in the UI rather than imported.
